say:1:1460707001:1.text: You drove off the Hypofiends! Good thing you reacted quickly. They didn't stand a chance.
say:1:1460707001:1.source_cn: 成功击退魔物了！幸好您反应迅速，没能让袭击的魔物得手。
say:1:1460707001:1.male: You drove off the Hypofiends! Good thing you reacted quickly. They didn't stand a chance.
say:1:1460707001:1.female: You drove off the Hypofiends! Good thing you reacted quickly. They didn't stand a chance.

say:2:1460707002:1.text: Yet who could have imagined... even now, Avalon would remain under threat from these creatures.
say:2:1460707002:1.source_cn: 只不过，没想到您的家园……阿瓦隆，时至今日依然被魔物威胁着。
say:2:1460707002:1.male: Yet who could have imagined... even now, Avalon would remain under threat from these creatures.
say:2:1460707002:1.female: Yet who could have imagined... even now, Avalon would remain under threat from these creatures.

say:3:1460707003:1.text: Maybe they've been trying to invade this blessed land the whole time you were gone.
say:3:1460707003:1.source_cn: 或许在您休息的时间里，他们一直在试图入侵这里，把这块福...
say:3:1460707003:1.male: Maybe they've been trying to invade this blessed land the whole time you were gone.
say:3:1460707003:1.female: Maybe they've been trying to invade this blessed land the whole time you were gone.

choice_prompt:4:1460707003.text: Maybe they've been trying to invade this blessed land the whole time you were gone.
choice_prompt:4:1460707003.source_cn: 或许在您休息的时间里，他们一直在试图入侵这里，把这块福地据为己有……
choice_prompt:4:1460707003.male: Maybe they've been trying to invade this blessed land the whole time you were gone.
choice_prompt:4:1460707003.female: Maybe they've been trying to invade this blessed land the whole time you were gone.

say:5:1460707004:1.text: Yes! We'll defend this land and push them back even harder each time.
say:5:1460707004:1.source_cn: 对，我们是不会投降的！不论他们入侵多少次，我们都会漂亮...

say:6:1460707005:1.text: And we'll weave life back into these fields! Till their shadows find no purchase here.
say:6:1460707005:1.source_cn: 不仅如此，我们还要让您的家园重新充满生机，让魔物的野心...
say:6:1460707005:1.male: And we'll weave life back into these fields! Till their shadows find no purchase here.
say:6:1460707005:1.female: And we'll weave life back into these fields! Till their shadows find no purchase here.

choice:4:0:1.text: Hypofiends are but shadows to the light.
choice:4:0:1.male: Hypofiends are but shadows to the light.
choice:4:0:1.female: Hypofiends are but shadows to the light.
